lines.t: Voices echo down the timeline,
Truths get lost inside the feed.
They sell us mirrors made of static,
And call the noise the thing we need.
But the heart still hums beneath the crossfire,
A whisper rising through the haze.
“Remember what you were before the scroll,”
It says.
I’m not my shadow in the screenlight,
I’m not the mask they made me wear.
Caught between the pulse and the silence,
I’m reaching out for something rare.
Wake me up, before I disappear—
Wake me up, before I disappear.
Smiles pixelate, eyes grow hollow,
Dreams reduced to dopamine.
Every promise feels recycled,
Every truth half-seen.
In the static, I hear the thunder—
A call from deep within the soul.
The volumes speak: let go the burden,
The kingdom’s found in taking hold.
I’m not my shadow in the screenlight,
I’m not the noise that fills the air.
Caught between the pulse and the silence,
I found the voice that answers prayer.
(YahuShua)
(Ohhhhh ohhhh)
(YahuShua)
Wake me up, I’m finally here—
Wake me up, I’m finally here.
